(2) The India Merit Scholarship terms text has a 2026/2027 reference in one place; the page uses 2027/28 only. fields.body_md:
## About this programme

The Business Administration, Master of (MBA) is a full-time programme. It lasts 12 months and runs on campus in Edinburgh, in the Central Area. The programme holds three accreditations: AACSB, EQUIS and AMBA. For the wider picture, read our [University of Edinburgh](/study-abroad/universities/university-of-edinburgh) page.

From September to March, every student takes 12 compulsory courses. They cover topics such as strategic leadership, finance, strategic marketing and operations improvement. From April, you choose electives. The MBA with International Exchange adds 2 to 3 months at one of the university's partner universities.

The most important rule for Indian applicants is work experience. You need at least three years in a managerial role. Managing can mean responsibility for a project, a team or tasks. You do not need the job title "manager".

## Can you get in?

**Degree.** You need a UK 2:1 honours degree in any subject, or an equivalent overseas qualification. For an Indian degree, check how the University rates your marks on its India entry requirements page before you apply.

**GMAT.** The GMAT is a business school admissions test. It is not compulsory for this MBA. The school may ask for it only if you do not meet the minimum academic requirement. If it does, the minimum score is 555, or 600 on the 10th Edition format.

**English.** IELTS (International English Language Testing System) is a test of English. You need an overall score of 7.0 on IELTS Academic, with at least 6.0 in each part. A skill retake is not accepted. These other tests are also accepted:

- TOEFL iBT, current version (from 21 January 2026): total 5.0, with at least 4.0 in each part. Earlier version: total 100, with at least 20 in each part.
- C1 Advanced or C2 Proficiency: total 185, with at least 169 in each part.
- Oxford ELLT: total 8, with at least 6 in each part.
- Oxford Test of English Advanced: total 155, with at least 135 in each part.

Your test must be no more than 2 years old. A degree taught in English in a majority-English-speaking country also counts.

**Selection.** After the second stage, you may be invited to an interview, in person or by online video. It covers your suitability and expectations.

## What it costs

- **Tuition: £47,680** for 2027/28 entry. The fee page lists this for the full-time MBA, and it is for one year only.
- **Tuition deposit: £2,500.** A deposit is an advance payment that counts towards your tuition. Pay it within 28 days of receiving your unconditional or conditional offer.
- **Application fee: none.** There is no fee to apply.
- **Living money for the visa.** Studying outside London, you must show £1,171 for each month of the course, up to 9 months. You must have held this money for 28 days in a row. The last day of that 28-day period must fall within 31 days of the day you apply.
- **Student visa fee: £558** when you apply from outside the UK.
- **Immigration Health Surcharge: £776 for each year of the visa.** This is the health fee you pay with your visa.

### Worked first-year total

| Item | Amount |
|---|---|
| Tuition, 2027/28 | £47,680 |
| Living money: £1,171 a month x 9 months | £10,539 |
| Student visa fee (from outside the UK) | £558 |
| Immigration Health Surcharge | £776 or more |
| **Total** | **at least £59,553** |

The arithmetic: £47,680 + £10,539 + £558 + £776 = £59,553. The £2,500 deposit is part of your tuition, so it is not added again.

Your visa lasts longer than your course, so you usually pay for more than one year. A 16-month visa costs £1,164. That is £776 for the first year, plus £388 for the extra months. For a visa of up to 18 months, the surcharge is the yearly cost plus half.

For other UK options, see the [UK total cost breakdown](/study-abroad/study-in/uk/uk-total-cost-breakdown).

## Funding

**India Merit Scholarship.** This award covers £5,000 towards tuition for the 2027/28 academic year. It is for the first year of study only. You may qualify if:

- you were domiciled in India when you applied,
- you pay international fees and are fully or partly self-funded,
- your Indian undergraduate degree meets the minimum grade in the scholarship's grade table. For the MBA, the minimums are 90% (100% scale), 9.5 (10-point CGPA), 7.5 (8-point CGPA), 6.6 (7-point CGPA) or 3.8 (4-point GPA),
- you join a full-time, on-campus taught master's course.

There is no separate application. Eligible students who accept an unconditional offer are awarded it automatically. Read the [India Merit Scholarship page](https://registryservices.ed.ac.uk/student-funding/postgraduate/international/region/asia/india-merit-scholarship) for the full terms.

**Graduate discount.** University of Edinburgh graduates get 10% off tuition. It is not open to students from India in general.

## Deadlines and intakes

| Round | Apply by | Decision by |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 14 Oct 2026 | 26 Nov 2026 |
| 2 | 25 Nov 2026 | 21 Jan 2027 |
| 3 | 27 Jan 2027 | 11 Mar 2027 |
| 4 | 3 Mar 2027 | 22 Apr 2027 |
| 5 | 21 Apr 2027 | 10 Jun 2027 |
| 6 | 9 Jun 2027 | 29 Jul 2027 |

These are the rounds for 2027/28 entry. Round 1 closed on 14 Oct 2026, so the next closing date is 25 Nov 2026 for Round 2. The school also makes offers to a few candidates on a rolling basis. The programme starts in mid-September, and the page also lists multiple start dates. Apply early: the earliest you can apply for the visa is 6 months before your course starts.

## How to apply

1. **Use the online portal.** Applications are accepted only through the online application portal, which you reach from the programme page. Select the award and duration, then the start date. The school cannot consider more than 5 applications from one applicant.
2. **Write a personal statement.** It is required.
3. **Send your CV and documents.** Submit a detailed CV, details of your knowledge or training, one professional reference, your English test evidence, and your degree certificates and transcripts. Add certified translations if they are not in English.
4. **Pay the deposit after your offer.** The £2,500 deposit is due within 28 days of your offer.
5. **Get your CAS.** A CAS (Confirmation of Acceptance for Studies) is the university's official confirmation that it has accepted you. Your visa application needs it.
6. **Apply for the visa.** You need your CAS, a valid passport and proof of money. The gov.uk guidance says a decision is usually within 3 weeks if you apply from outside the UK.

Two more visa checks. A TB test may be needed, because India is on the list of countries where it applies. It must be done at a Home Office approved clinic. Some courses need an ATAS certificate. Ask the university whether yours does.

## After the programme

- **Careers support.** You get one-to-one MBA career consultations and a credit-bearing Professional Development course.
- **Final assignment.** Towards the end, you write a 7,500-word problem-solving assignment. It can follow a research, consultancy or business-plan pathway.
- **Careers.** The programme page says the MBA "can lead to a variety of specialised careers". Its examples run from chief strategy officer to senior procurement specialist.
- **Graduate visa.** The Graduate visa is the post-study work visa. It lasts 2 years if you apply on or before 31 December 2026, and 18 months if you apply on or after 1 January 2027. Because this programme starts in 2027, the 18-month rule applies. The application fee is £937. Read the [Graduate visa guide on gov.uk](https://www.gov.uk/graduate-visa).

## Who it suits

**A strong choice if:**

- you have at least three years in a managerial role,
- you can reach IELTS 7.0, with at least 6.0 in each part,
- you want a one-year, full-time MBA in Edinburgh with three accreditations,
- you want the option of 2 to 3 months on exchange,
- you may qualify for the £5,000 India Merit Scholarship.

**Think carefully if:**

- you do not yet have three years of managerial experience,
- you cannot show the first-year total of at least £59,553,
- you cannot pay the £2,500 deposit within 28 days of your offer.

## Sources

Checked on 3 November 2026: [MBA programme page](https://study.ed.ac.uk/programmes/postgraduate-taught/267-business-administration-master-of), [MBA fee page](https://study.ed.ac.uk/programmes/postgraduate-taught-campus-fees?programme_code=PTMBABUSAD5F&year=2027), [India Merit Scholarship](https://registryservices.ed.ac.uk/student-funding/postgraduate/international/region/asia/india-merit-scholarship), [Immigration Health Surcharge](https://www.gov.uk/healthcare-immigration-application/how-much-pay).

Checked on 1 November 2026: [Student visa](https://www.gov.uk/student-visa), [Financial evidence for the student route](https://www.gov.uk/guidance/financial-evidence-for-student-and-child-student-route-applicants), [Graduate visa](https://www.gov.uk/graduate-visa), [Graduate visa costs](https://www.gov.uk/graduate-visa/how-much-it-costs), [TB test for visa](https://www.gov.uk/tb-test-visa), [ATAS](https://www.gov.uk/guidance/academic-technology-approval-scheme).

Fees and rules change. Always confirm on the university's own website before you pay or apply.

faq_json.q: How much is the MBA at the University of Edinburgh for Indian students?
faq_json.a: For 2027/28 entry, the tuition fee is £47,680 for the full-time MBA. The fee is for one year only. With living money, the visa fee and the health surcharge, the first-year total is at least £59,553.

faq_json.q: Do I need a GMAT score for the Edinburgh MBA?
faq_json.a: The GMAT is not compulsory. The school may ask for it only if you do not meet the minimum academic requirement. If it is required, the minimum score is 555, or 600 on the 10th Edition format.

faq_json.q: What IELTS score do I need for the Edinburgh MBA?
faq_json.a: You need an overall IELTS Academic score of 7.0, with at least 6.0 in each part. TOEFL iBT, C1 Advanced, C2 Proficiency, Oxford ELLT and the Oxford Test of English Advanced are also accepted.

faq_json.q: Is there a scholarship for Indian students on the Edinburgh MBA?
faq_json.a: Yes. The India Merit Scholarship covers £5,000 towards tuition for the 2027/28 academic year, for the first year of study only. There is no separate application. Eligible students who accept an unconditional offer receive it automatically.

faq_json.q: How much money do I need to show for the UK student visa?
faq_json.a: Studying outside London, you must show £1,171 for each month of the course, up to 9 months. That is £10,539 for 9 months. You must have held the money for 28 days in a row.

faq_json.q: When is the next application deadline for the MBA?
faq_json.a: Round 1 closed on 14 Oct 2026. The next deadline is Round 2 on 25 Nov 2026, with decisions by 21 Jan 2027. The school makes some offers on a rolling basis.
